description.text: The second expansion pack of the Pokémon Card e series, released in Japan on 8 March 2002 in packs of five cards. It is set in a harbour town that spreads out around a clock tower at the edge of the series' mysterious continent. Its cards are numbered to 92. In English it was combined with the next pack, Wind from the Sea, into Aquapolis, released in January 2003.
